documents.title: Automations
documents.description: Automate work in a workspace — list automations and reach their create, edit, copy, and delete operations.

documents.title: Create Automation
documents.description: Create an automation with a trigger and one or more actions that run when the trigger fires.

documents.title: Edit Automation
documents.description: Update an existing automation's trigger, actions, or active state with the editAutomation mutation.

documents.title: Copy Automation
documents.description: Duplicate an existing automation, including its trigger and all actions, into your current workspace.

documents.title: Delete Automation
documents.description: Permanently delete an automation and clean up its schedules, due-date jobs, and caches.

documents.title: Charts
documents.description: Create, build, preview, recalculate, export, and query the STAT, PIE, and BAR charts that live inside a dashboard.

documents.title: Create and manage charts
documents.description: Create STAT, PIE, and BAR charts on a dashboard, then rename, reposition, restyle, duplicate, and delete them.

documents.title: Build chart segments and values
documents.description: Create, edit, and delete the segments and values that drive a manual chart — formula logic plus project-scoped aggregations.

documents.title: Preview, recalculate, and export charts
documents.description: Compute a throwaway chart preview, force-recalculate saved charts, and export chart data to CSV with previewChart, recalculateCharts, and exportChartCSV.

documents.title: Query and subscribe to charts
documents.description: Read a single chart by id, list every chart on a dashboard, and subscribe to real-time chart create, update, and delete events.

documents.title: Create a Checklist
documents.description: Add a checklist to a record with createChecklist, and query checklist items across your whole organization.
headings: Query checklist items across your organization

documents.title: Manage Checklists
documents.description: Rename, reposition, and delete checklists on records with the editChecklist and deleteChecklist mutations.

documents.title: Checklist Items
documents.description: Add, edit, and delete checklist items on a record, manage assignees, and set start and due dates.

documents.title: Comments overview
documents.description: How comments and discussions work in Blue - one polymorphic Comment type attaches to records, discussions, and status updates, plus threading, reactions, and live updates.
headings: A comment on a record, a discussion, and a status update —
same mutation, only category + categoryId differ.

documents.title: Create, edit & delete comments
documents.description: Post, edit, and soft-delete comments on any record, discussion, or status update with one polymorphic set of mutations.

documents.title: Query comments
documents.description: Fetch comments for any record, discussion, or status update with the commentList query — scoped by category, paginated, and ordered.

documents.title: Create, update & delete discussions
documents.description: Open project-scoped discussion threads, rename them, and hard-delete them with the createDiscussion, updateDiscussion, and deleteDiscussion mutations.

documents.title: Query discussions
documents.description: Fetch discussions three ways - one by ID, an offset-paginated org-wide list, or a cursor-paginated list scoped to a single project you belong to.

documents.title: Reactions
documents.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction on a comment and read back the comment's full set of reaction groups.

documents.title: Custom Fields
documents.description: Extend records with typed custom fields - 26 field types, field-level access control, and the operations to create, read, and write them.

documents.title: Create a Custom Field
documents.description: Add a custom field to a workspace with type-specific configuration via the createCustomField mutation.
headings: Date field flagged as the due date

documents.title: List Custom Fields
documents.description: Read the custom fields in a workspace with type filtering and sorting via the customFields query.

documents.title: Set Custom Field Values
documents.description: Write values to custom fields on a record with the type-specific parameter each field expects.

documents.title: Delete a Custom Field
documents.description: Permanently remove a custom field from a workspace, clearing its values on every record.

documents.title: Single-Line Text Field
documents.description: Store short single-line text — names, codes, references — on a record with the TEXT_SINGLE custom field type.

documents.title: Multi-Line Text Field
documents.description: Store longer free-form text — descriptions, notes, logs — on a record with the TEXT_MULTI custom field type.

documents.title: Currency Custom Field
documents.description: Store a monetary amount and its currency on a record, with an optional default currency and min/max range.
headings: Setting a value while creating a record

documents.title: Multi-Select Field
documents.description: Store multiple choices from a predefined list of options on a record with a SELECT_MULTI custom field.

documents.title: Checkbox Field
documents.description: Store a single boolean (checked/unchecked) value on records for flags, approvals, and confirmations.
headings: Set a value at record creation

documents.title: Email Field
documents.description: Store email addresses on records with an EMAIL custom field — set, read, and filter the value.
headings: Set the value when creating a record

documents.title: URL Field
documents.description: Store website addresses and links on records with a URL custom field — set, read, and optionally render as a button.
headings: Render the URL as a button
Set the value when creating a record

documents.title: Percent Field
documents.description: Store percentage values on records. Blue strips the % symbol on input and keeps the raw number internally.

documents.title: Single-Select Field
documents.description: Store one choice from a predefined option list on a record — for status, priority, category, or any controlled single-choice value.

documents.title: Date Field
documents.description: Store a single date, a date range, or an all-day event on a record, with timezone-aware storage.
headings: Set a value at record creation

documents.title: Location Custom Field
documents.description: Store geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) on a record, with coordinate-range validation when records are created.
headings: Setting a location when creating a record

documents.title: Number Custom Field
documents.description: Store numeric values on records, with optional min/max bounds and a display prefix.
headings: Set a value at record creation

documents.title: Country Custom Field
documents.description: Store one or more countries on a record as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, with name-to-code conversion when records are created.
headings: Setting a country when creating a record

documents.title: File Custom Field
documents.description: Attach uploaded files to records with a file custom field, then read them back via the field's files list.
headings: Step 2 — Attach the file to the record

documents.title: Button Field
documents.description: Create button fields that fire a CUSTOM_FIELD_BUTTON_CLICKED automation trigger when a user clicks them on a record.

documents.title: Rating Custom Field
documents.description: Store a numeric rating on a record, with an optional lower bound and an upper bound that caps the scale.
headings: Set a value at record creation

documents.title: Currency Conversion Field
documents.description: Create fields that automatically convert a record's currency value into other currencies using daily exchange rates.
headings: Step 1 — Create the source Currency field
Step 2 — Create the Currency Conversion field

documents.title: Reference Field
documents.description: Link records to records in another workspace, with optional filtering and single- or multi-select.

documents.title: Assignee Field
documents.description: Assign one or more users to a record through a custom field, separate from the record's built-in assignees.

documents.title: Formula Field
documents.description: Aggregate custom field values (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX) for charts and dashboards.

documents.title: Time Duration Custom Field
documents.description: Auto-calculate the elapsed time between two events on a record — cycle times, response times, SLAs.
headings: Time spent in a specific list (start when moved in, end when moved out)
Time from assignment to first status change

documents.title: Lookup Field
documents.description: Pull live data from records linked through a Reference field, with no manual copying.

documents.title: Referenced By Field
documents.description: Surface the records in another workspace that reference this record through a reference field - the reverse of a reference.

documents.title: Unique ID Field
documents.description: Auto-generate sequential identifiers on records — ticket numbers, order IDs, invoice numbers — with the UNIQUE_ID custom field type.

documents.title: Rollup Field
documents.description: Aggregate a field across the records reached through a reference or referenced-by field - sum, average, count, min, max, or join.

documents.title: Phone Custom Field
documents.description: Create phone fields to store and validate phone numbers with international formatting

documents.title: List Dashboards
documents.description: Retrieve a paginated list of the dashboards you can access in an organization using the dashboards query.

documents.title: Create Dashboard
documents.description: Create a dashboard in an organization (optionally scoped to a workspace) using the createDashboard mutation.

documents.title: Edit Dashboard
documents.description: Rename a dashboard and manage who can view or edit it with the editDashboard mutation.

documents.title: Copy Dashboard
documents.description: Duplicate a dashboard with all its charts, segments, and viewer permissions using the copyDashboard mutation.

documents.title: Delete Dashboard
documents.description: Permanently delete a dashboard and all of its charts using the Blue API.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Two project-scoped document subsystems - collaboratively-edited rich-text Documents (and Wiki pages) and Portable Document PDF templates you fill from record data.

documents.title: Create and edit documents
documents.description: Create, update, and delete rich-text Documents and Wiki pages in a workspace, including the content/contentBase64 split and the anti-wipe guard.

documents.title: Query and subscribe to documents
documents.description: Fetch a single rich-text document, list a workspace's documents with filtering, sorting and pagination, and subscribe to real-time create/update/delete events.

documents.title: Build Portable Document templates
documents.description: Turn an uploaded PDF into a Portable Document template, then rename, delete, fetch, or list a project's templates.

documents.title: Map fields and print Portable Documents
documents.description: Place overlay fields that bind a record's attributes onto a Portable Document page, then print a filled PDF for any record.

documents.title: Custom Domains & Email
documents.description: Serve Blue on your own domain and brand the transactional email Blue sends on your behalf.

documents.title: Custom Domains
documents.description: Serve Blue on your own hostname — create, verify via DNS, and list custom domains for your organization.
headings: Setting up a custom domain end to end

documents.title: SMTP Credentials
documents.description: Route Blue's outbound mail through your own SMTP server, with a live connection test and a standalone verify call.

documents.title: Email Templates
documents.description: Override the subject, body, and CTA of Blue's transactional emails, and send a one-off test message to preview your copy.

documents.title: Uploading Files
documents.description: Upload files to Blue via a one-step GraphQL mutation or a presigned-PUT REST flow for large files.

Attaching files to records and comments
Attaching files to a file custom field

documents.title: Forms
documents.description: Build public forms with the GraphQL API — create a form, configure its fields, and collect submissions that become records in a workspace.

documents.title: Export Records
documents.description: Export workspace records to a CSV file delivered by email, with optional filters for assignees, tags, dates, and custom fields.

documents.title: Export CSV Template
documents.description: Download a pre-formatted CSV template with the correct column headers for bulk-importing records into a workspace.

documents.title: Import Records
documents.description: Bulk-import records into a workspace from a CSV file and track progress through a real-time subscription.

documents.description: Store an OAuth2 credential in a workspace by supplying tokens you already obtained, so HTTP automations can call third-party APIs as you.

documents.title: List OAuth Connections
documents.description: Query the OAuth connections in a workspace with the oauthConnections query — filter by workspace, sort, and paginate.

documents.title: Update and Delete a Connection
documents.description: Rename a connection, delete it, and subscribe to real-time create/update/delete events for a workspace.

documents.title: Organization Management
documents.description: Create, read, list, and update the organizations a user belongs to in the Blue API.

documents.title: Create an Organization

documents.title: Query an Organization
documents.description: Retrieve an organization's profile, plan, and limits by ID or slug with the company query.

documents.title: Record & Todo-List Subscriptions
documents.description: Real-time GraphQL subscriptions for records and lists — change feeds, action history, the badge counter, and move/done events.

documents.title: Project & Workspace Subscriptions
documents.description: Real-time streams for workspace lifecycle, membership, folders, tags, and saved views over the GraphQL WebSocket.

documents.title: Comments, Discussions & Chat
documents.description: Real-time GraphQL subscriptions for comments, typing indicators, discussions, status updates, AI chat, and collaborative documents.

documents.title: Custom Field Subscriptions
documents.description: Stream real-time changes to custom field definitions and their options so a client's field schema stays in sync.

documents.title: File & Link Subscriptions
documents.description: Stream file and link changes over WebSocket — scope by organization, workspace, or folder, and react to batch deletions in real time.

headings: …and more — see the schema for the complete set.

documents.title: User Presence
documents.description: Stream who is online and live organization membership — presence status, company changes, and project invitations over the realtime WebSocket.

documents.title: Progress & Long-Running Jobs
documents.description: Stream progress on async server jobs — imports/exports, lookups, AI tagging, cover generation, automation runs, and OAuth connections.

documents.title: Dashboards, Charts & Community
documents.description: Live streams for dashboards, charts, form changes, and the community feed — the remaining real-time channels in one place.

documents.title: Records
documents.description: Create, read, update, and organize records - the core unit of work in Blue, modeled as Todo objects in the API.

documents.description: Query, filter, sort, and paginate records across your organization with the todos query.
headings: List all records in a workspace

documents.title: Toggle Record Status
documents.description: Mark a record complete or incomplete with the updateTodoDoneStatus mutation, either by toggling or by setting an explicit state.

documents.title: Move Record to List
documents.description: Move a record to a different list, within the same workspace or across workspaces, with the moveTodo mutation.

documents.title: Copy Record
documents.description: Duplicate a record into any list, choosing exactly which elements carry over.

documents.title: Record Assignees
documents.description: Set, add, or remove the users assigned to a record, and list the users eligible to be assigned.

documents.title: Tags
documents.description: Create, list, edit, and delete tags, apply them to records, and trigger AI tagging with the Blue API.

documents.title: Add Comment
documents.description: Add a comment to a record with rich HTML content, file attachments, @mentions, and threaded replies.

documents.title: Dependencies
documents.description: Link records into blocking relationships, change a dependency's direction, or remove it with the dependency mutations.

documents.title: Recurring Records
documents.description: Attach a repeating schedule to a record so Blue automatically generates copies on a defined cadence.

headings: Filter records by time in list

documents.title: Archive a Record
documents.description: Archive and restore records to hide them from active lists without deleting their data.

documents.title: Reports
documents.description: Aggregate records across one or more workspaces into a single saved analytical view with counts, field aggregations, and CSV export.

documents.title: Create a Report
documents.description: Create a report scoped to one or more data sources, each targeting a set of workspaces and a JSON filter.

documents.title: Query Reports
documents.description: Fetch a single report by id or list the reports in an organization, with pagination and the full Report field reference.

documents.title: Report Data & Aggregations
documents.description: Read a report's combined records, counts, and per-field sum/avg/min/max aggregations, and refresh its cached results.

documents.title: Manage Report Access
documents.description: Update a report's title, description, config, and data sources, and share it with EDITOR/VIEWER collaborators.

documents.title: Duplicate & Delete a Report
documents.description: Clone a report and its data sources, or hard-delete a report and its data sources, with the duplicateReport and deleteReport mutations.

documents.title: Export a Report

documents.title: Saved Views
documents.description: Store and share workspace layouts - board, table, calendar, timeline, and map views with their filters, sorting, grouping, and columns.

documents.title: List Saved Views
documents.description: Read the saved views in a workspace, or fetch one by ID, via the savedViews and savedView queries.

documents.title: Update Saved View
documents.description: Edit a saved view, reorder it, and set workspace or personal default views in a Blue workspace.

documents.title: Delete Saved View
documents.description: Permanently delete a saved view from a Blue workspace and clear any default-view references that pointed to it.
